positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
• Worked on Automatic Flight Control System.
• Participated in automating flight system testing.
• Mentored interns.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineering Student Intern
positions.description:
•	Researched and developed optical solutions for customer needs.
•	Wrote and maintained mission-critical programs for various systems.
•	Designed a PCB for the UV sterilization system to interface between raspberry pi and the rest of the system.
•	Participated in the assembly process of the UV sterilization system.
• Built and tested programs for micron scale laser ablation system.
• Implemented various algorithms and cut down run time of ablation experiment by 80%.
positions.insights: Skills: Graphical User Interface (GUI) · Embedded Systems · Electrical Wiring · Optics · Electrical Engineering · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Raspberry Pi · Algorithms · Embedded Software Programming · Autodesk EAGLE · Research and Development (R&D)

company.name: BYU Ira A. Fulton College of Engineering

positions.title: University Rover Challenge - Robot Programmer
positions.description:
• Won 3rd place on the world wide University Rover Challenge 2023.
• Implemented a GUI to control tasks, and show map visualization.
• Worked in a fairly large team by using Git/GitHub with Agile Project Management.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Maintained department’s capstone website using the Drupal content management system.
•	Worked with version control using Git and GitLab.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Gitlab · PHP · Git · Drupal · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

company.name: BYU Ira A. Fulton College of Engineering

positions.title: Flight information / Marshalling specialist
positions.description:
•	Managed flight information and schedule of the airbase.
•	Guided and supported aircraft from other airbases.
•	Worked at ground control tower assisting aircraft to land safely.
•	Created a work automation system using Microsoft Excel.
positions.insights: Skills: Air Force · Military · Microsoft Office · Military Aircraft

positions.title: Document Controller
positions.description:
•	Created filing and archiving system for documents and checked metadata according to client’s requirements.
•	Reported on document control processes and checked incoming documents for readiness prior to processing.
•	Ensured accessibility, traceability, and accuracy of documents and controlled workflow management and document distribution.

positions.title: Mobile Robotics Competition - Robot Programmer
positions.description:
•	Won 1st place in the regional competition and 6th place in the national competition.
•	Programmed robots in C and performed troubleshooting to identify solutions when malfunctioned.
•	Designed and built robots to solve tasks given for the competition.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Embedded Systems · Bare-Metal Embedded System · Mobile Robotics · Atmel AVR · Teamwork

honors.title: BYU Robotics Competition 1st Place
honors.description:
•	Built and programmed a robot in C to solve given problem as a team.
•	Optimized algorithms and used PID control to stabilize the robot movement and shorten lab times.
honors.issuer: Issued by BYU Electrical and Computer Engineering - Experimental Leaning Center · Nov 2020

honors.title: World Skills Competition - Mobile Robotics [Gold Medal]
honors.description:
•	Programmed robots in C and performed troubleshooting to identify solutions when malfunctioned.
•	Designed and built robots to solve tasks given for the competition and won a Gold Medal.
honors.issuer: Issued by World Skills Competition Korea · Apr 2012

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Provided 10-12 hours of community services to families and assisted two local food/shelter agencies each day.
•	Led through quantitative goal setting, reviewing past goals, learning new teaching/contact methods, and increasing team member morale.
